description: Smooth a 3D Mass — rounds its footprint corners (more Iterations = rounder) so the extruded mass has smooth faces → a new Mass. Feed a Mass from Space to 3D / Inset 3D.
instructions: A Mass op — rounds each incoming Mass's footprint corners (Chaikin corner-cutting; more Iterations = rounder) so the extruded mass has smooth vertical faces, producing a new Mass. Feed a Mass (from a Mass node / Space → 3D / Inset 3D).
